decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the cleaner left arm without a conventional Roman flare, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The left-arm terminal refinement applies to the Hero V; the É accent remains deferred until the Hero V is resolved, and its existing derivation rule remains valid unchanged.
The source does not establish a terminal treatment for the second V; its existing requirement to derive later from the resolved Hero V geometry already captures the necessary relationship.
Refining the Hero V's left-arm termination does not change the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its role.
The source postpones the remainder of the wordmark and does not apply the Hero V's left-arm terminal construction to the internal letterforms.
The Hero V terminal refinement does not change the deferred complete-wordmark composition, kerning, or visual hierarchy requirements.
The structural refinement leaves unchanged the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
The cleaner, non-decorative terminal is consistent with the existing brand-expression constraints but does not necessarily modify their current state.
